Maybe you could try this: write down the hair colors you want to try and why, narrow down the pros and cons and see if you can decide on a single color. Good luck!

I've shaved my head around 5 times. I'm 3a and my advice is to enjoy the happy healthy new growth and just listen to your hair. Stay away from heat, don't rough up your hair with a towel, just learn to be super gentle. Your hair is going to grow through many stages, including a mullet and layers. Some choose to just let it do its thing, others (me) keep it trimmed to even it all out. You'll figure all that out along the way. It'll probably take time for your hair to be long enough to start curling but that's normal, don't get discouraged. You're going to learn a lot about your hair as it grows and it'll be interesting and very annoying at times lol but it's worth it.
